messages:
maria.p: Proposing Thurmont dedicated swap for Fri 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. Customer expects short burst for model warmup. Need capacity reservation + KMS check. cc @infra-scheduler @ops-oncall

tony: What's the exact image we're cutting? Do we include config flag --enable-prefix-cache? Also any known perf deltas vs current prod image?

deploy-bot: (/deploy) New schedule request received: tenant=thurmont requester=maria.p time=2026-04-02T03:00:00Z
deploy-bot: Suggested image: redwood/inference:v1.15.0 (sha256:cb9e12)

ops-oncall: KMS: customer has scheduled key rotation 2026-04-02T04:00Z so safe window exists. Recommend set kms-rotate=true after cutover (post-03:30).

infra-scheduler: Capacity note: dedicated pool currently has no burst reservation. I can reserve 3 gpus for 03:00-03:45 UTC if we authorize now. This will permit priming without impacting other tenants.

maria.p: Approve reserve=3 gpus 03:00-03:45 UTC. Yes include --enable-prefix-cache=true. We will pin to v1.15.0 and enable feature-flag ephemeral-cache for trial.

perf: Perf summary for v1.15.0 (internal): p50 ~ +3% vs v1.14.1, p95 ~ +7% under heavy long-seq traffic. Improvements: memory leak fix, KV eviction tuning. Known limitation: function-calling throughput not validated for burst > 600 qps. Recommend canary for 30m.

release-coordinator: Proposed plan:
- 03:00 UTC: switch slice-1 (10% traffic) to v1.15.0 with ephemeral-cache on
- 03:10 UTC: run smoke checks (end-to-end, func-call flakiness, sync latency)
- 03:20 UTC: increase to 40% if stable
- 03:40 UTC: evaluate and either complete to 100% or roll forward to v1.15.0-force (if minor degradations) or rollback to v1.14.1
Rollback triggers:
- error_rate > 1.2x baseline sustained for 5m
- p95 increase > 25% absolute and > 500ms
- function-call failures > 0.5%

tony: Leaving exact commands here for runbook:
```bash
# schedule (ops)
deployctl schedule --tenant thurmont --when 2026-04-02T03:00Z --image redwood/inference:v1.15.0 --pin-version --args "--enable-prefix-cache=true --ephemeral-cache=true" --note "thurmont dedicated swap"
# prime cache
kv-prime --tenant thurmont --file ./thurmont-top-prefixes.txt --concurrency 12 --start 2026-04-02T02:50Z
# emergency rollback
deployctl rollback --tenant thurmont --to-image redwood/inference:v1.14.1 --reason "auto/ops rollback" --force-if-degraded
routingctl hold --tenant thurmont --scope slice-1
```

deploy-bot: Action items logged: ITEM-7110 (reserve gpus), ITEM-7111 (pin image v1.15.0), ITEM-7112 (canary monitors). Schedule id=642800

maria.p: Can someone confirm who will watch alerts and be primary to run rollback if needed?

ops-oncall: I'll own alerts during window and have pager escalation ready. Will escalate to tony then release-coordinator if manual rollback needed.

infra-scheduler: Reservation request submitted: res-9001 (3 gpus 2026-04-02T03:00-03:45Z). Please don't forget to release if not used.

perf: I'll push a lightweight synthetic load at 03:05 for 2 minutes to validate burst behavior. Will post telemetry link here.

release-coordinator: Added short customer-facing blurb to release notes: https://redwood-internal/relnotes/thurmont-2026-04-02. Include warning about function-calling throughput unvalidated for extreme bursts.

maria.p: Everyone ack? If no objections I'll mark the schedule by EOD UTC today.

tony: ack

ops-oncall: ack

infra-scheduler: ack

perf: ack (will post metrics after synthetic run)

deploy-bot: Schedule confirmed: id=642800 tenant=thurmont time=2026-04-02T03:00Z image=v1.15.0 pin_version=true

release-coordinator: Leaving thread open for late notes. If anything changes ping here or update the schedule. Thanks all.
